examples.title: Disabled action
examples.description: Keeps an unauthorized action visible with an accessible scope reason.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { AccessGate } from '@lostgradient/cinder';
  import { Button } from '@lostgradient/cinder';

  const canCancelWorkflow = false;
</script>

<AccessGate granted={canCancelWorkflow} reason="Requires scope: workflows:cancel">
  <Button label="Cancel workflow" variant="danger" />
</AccessGate>

examples.title: Locked section
examples.description: Replaces a protected region with a scope-required placeholder.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { AccessGate } from '@lostgradient/cinder';
</script>

<AccessGate
  granted={false}
  variant="section"
  reason="Requires scope: storage:admin"
  requirement="storage:admin"
/>

examples.title: Forbidden page
examples.description: The full-page layout for a page with nothing readable: what is blocked, the missing scope on its own line, and where to look.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { AccessGate, Button } from '@lostgradient/cinder';
</script>

<AccessGate
  granted={false}
  variant="section"
  layout="page"
  headingLevel={1}
  title="Your sign-in can’t open Hooks"
  reason="Settings › API reference › Your scopes shows what it can do."
  requirement="hooks:read"
>
  {#snippet actions()}
    <Button variant="secondary" label="See your scopes" />
    <Button variant="secondary" label="Back to Home" />
  {/snippet}
</AccessGate>
